blocks.text: LUCENA CITY—Two men were arrested for allegedly engaging in the unauthorized transfer and trading of petroleum products during an anti-illegal fuel operation in Batangas City on Friday, Nov. 6, police said. The Police Regional Office 4A (PRO-4A) said in a report on Saturday that the Batangas police intelligence unit received information from a concerned citizen about the alleged siphoning and unauthorized transport of petroleum products in Barangay Banaba West. At 4:20 p.m., police officers conducting surveillance spotted the two men siphoning fuel from a 10-wheeler tanker truck.
